svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Extreme poverty is defined as living below the
International Poverty Line of $3 per day. This data is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs

tspan.tspan: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021

text.tspan: prices. It relates to income (measured after taxes and
benefits) or to consumption, per capita.
